Bill.BriefDescription: Ensuring benefit equality among local government employees.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to ensuring nondiscrimination in the amount ofhealth care benefits provided to local government employees; adding anew section to chapter 35.21 RCW; adding a new section to chapter35A.21 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 36.01 RCW; and adding a newsection to chapter 53.18 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any city or town that provides health care benefits or services toits employees may not discriminate among classes of its employees as tothe amount of benefits provided.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35A.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any code city that provides health care benefits or services to itsemployees may not discriminate among classes of its employees as to theamount of benefits provided.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any county that provides health care benefits or services to itsemployees may not discriminate among classes of its employees as to theamount of benefits provided.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 53.18 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any port district that provides health care benefits or services toits employees may not discriminate among classes of its employees as tothe amount of benefits provided.
